activity.notes: Shah Murad established the Manghit emirate form of rule in Bukhara in 1785 and ruled as emir until his death around the turn of 1799-1800. Modern reference works disagree between a precise death on 19 December 1799 and the conventional dynastic endpoint 1800, so ATLAS keeps 1785 exact at year granularity and marks the end c.1800.

sources.title: Bukhara, Khanate and Emirate of — Encyclopedia.com
sources.citation_text: The encyclopedia identifies Shah Murad as the Manghit ruler who abolished the khanate form and ruled Bukhara as emir from 1785 to 1800.

sources.title: A History of Inner Asia
sources.citation_text: The dynastic appendix lists Mir Masum Shah Murad as the first Manghit emir of Bukhara, 1785-1800.
